Folio native UI cover fixtures

ui-cover-light.png, ui-cover-letter.jpg, ui-cover-mountain.png are original
geometric illustrations generated by ../make_ui_cover_fixtures.py for the
fictional UI test books 一页微光, 南方来信 and 山间日记. They are test images,
not the user's books, downloaded published covers, or built-in firmware art.

The UI regression links the production PNG/JPEG decoder. Its EPUB extraction
stub supplies ui-cover-light.png as embedded image bytes. The other two images
are copied to the fake card as 南方来信.jpg and 山间日记.png to exercise actual
same-name sidecar lookup for TXT. Books without images exercise the fallback.

The tested page text and reading statistics are also synthetic test fixtures.
No test cover, font, or synthetic history is embedded in the firmware binary.

Generation on the development Mac uses the local Songti Regular font solely to
render titles into these test images. The font itself is not redistributed.
